Each type gives you precise control over how your video elements move, transform, or appear on screen. When you add keyframes in CapCut, you can combine these types to bring your creative vision to life. Here’s a closer look at each one. ### Position Keyframes Position keyframes control how an object or layer moves across the screen. By setting them at different points in the timeline, you can define the path and [speed ramp](https://www.capcut.com/tools/speed-ramp) of the motion, creating smooth and natural animation. This is perfect for moving text, graphics, or clips dynamically within your video. ![Large red heart sticker overlays a coastal sunset while CapCut shows sticker choices and position controls](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/6a6219531c5042bd8b43bd4d05323e08~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) ### Scale Keyframes Scale keyframes adjust the size of an object or layer. You can set different scale values to zoom in or out at specific moments, helping to draw attention to important parts of your video or create dramatic visual emphasis. ![Coastal sunset enlarged to 300 percent in CapCut with the scale control and keyframe markers highlighted](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/1c7f0227820a4138880eb9848a52af72~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) ### Rotation Keyframes Rotation keyframes control the spinning or orientation of an element. By adding these keyframes, you can create rotating logos, turning objects, or subtle camera-like tilts that make your video more dynamic and engaging. Read [How to Rotate a Video](https://www.capcut.com/resource/how-to-rotate-videos) for more details. ![Coastline footage rotated vertically in CapCut with the 90-degree rotation setting highlighted](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/5c806755ed5d41b1a7410112ded66e12~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) ### Opacity Keyframes Opacity keyframes manage the transparency of your layers. They’re great for fade-in and fade-out effects, or for making elements gradually appear or disappear. This technique helps you achieve clean transitions and layered visual effects. ![CapCut coastline project with opacity set to 67 percent and diamond keyframe buttons marked by arrows](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/1b94c4f432034c4bbc5927dffc0fb686~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) ### Effect Keyframes Effect keyframes let you animate specific visual effects applied to your clips, such as color, brightness, or filters. By adjusting effect parameters over time, you can build complex, evolving visuals that add energy and depth to your project. ![Mosaic blur covers a sunset preview while CapCut displays video effects and detailed adjustment sliders](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/e0a8c6e7c056402bb6d80071c43124a3~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) ### Audio Keyframes Audio keyframes give you control over sound properties like volume or balance. Setting them at different points allows you to fade audio in or out smoothly, match sound intensity to visual motion, and fine-tune your overall sound design. ![Happy Moments audio track under a sunset clip with volume controls and a keyframe button on the right](https://p16-seeyou-useast5.capcutcdn-us.com/tos-useast5-i-2zwwjm3azk-tx/afb2522ebe0b42d3b8e9517a075dc2dd~tplv-2zwwjm3azk-compress:q75.image) When you combine these different types of keyframe animation in CapCut, you can achieve cinematic-quality results with precise timing, fluid transitions, and a professional finish, all within an easy-to-use platform that also offers a [Free Online Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/online-video-editor) for quick edits on the go. ## How to add keyframes in CapCut PC Here’s a quick guide on how to add keyframes in CapCut on PC to create smooth, dynamic keyframe animation effects. ## How to add keyframes in CapCut

### **Step 1: Start a new project**

1\. Open CapCut's editor in your web browser.

2\. Click "Create new" and under the "Video" tile select the video ratio for your project.

3\. Upload media or use stock videos in the multitrack edito

### Step 2: Add keyframes to video

1\. Select a video clip in the multitrack editor.2. Go to the 'Basic' tab in the upper-right control panel.3. Find the property you wish to animate (e.g., Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity).4. Click the keyframe icon (often a diamond shape) next to the property at your desired starting frame to set the first keyframe.5. Move the playhead to a later point in the timeline.6. Adjust the property value (e.g., change the position or increase the scale). 7. A new keyframe will be added automatically, creating a smooth transition between the two points.Pro Tip: Use the integrated 'Speed Curve' or graph editor (usually accessible near the keyframe points) to refine the timing and feel of the motion, making it fast at the start and slow at the end (ease-out).

### Step 3: Export and share

1\. Review your animation and apply any final edits.

2\. Click Export to download or share the finished video with one click for presentations, reviews, or social media.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is key frame?

Keyframing is a feature that allows you to create motion graphics and smooth animation. To create a motion sequence, you need to define your object's starting and ending points. These markers are referred to as keyframes. Use CapCut to employ video keyframes with our easy-to-use user interface. Besides keyframe effects, you can add [speed curve](https://www.capcut.com/tools/speed-ramp) to smooth your video clips.

### **What are the best keyframe animation examples?**

Keyframe animation is widely used in both video games and animated movies to bring characters and scenes to life. Here are some prime examples:Video games: Character movements (running, jumping, etc.) are all driven by keyframes.Movies: Animated classics like The Lion King and Avatar use keyframes to animate everything from characters to environments.CapCut's keyframe tools help you create similar high-quality animations for your projects, taking your content to the next level.

### **How can I use the keyframe effect on CapCut online video edit**  t online video editor?

### **How does keyframe video editing work?**

Keyframe video editing combines art and technology by allowing precise control over an animation's properties. Here's how it works:Set keyframes at specific points to define changes in position, opacity, scale, and more.The video automatically interpolates the movement or change between keyframes.CapCut lets you adjust keyframe timing and combine them with tools like speed curves for smoother transitions.

### **Can I add keyframes to animated movies?**

Yes, absolutely. Keyframe technology is fundamental to creating animated movies and applying complex visual effects.Classic examples: Movies like 'The Lion King', 'Guardians of the Galaxy', and 'Avatar' have been made using keyframe technology.Creating stunning content: Using CapCut's keyframe video editing tools, you can create stunning movies and content for free.

### Can a team review and edit a keyframe animation project?

A team space is available for editing, reviewing, and sharing cloud-based projects. Check the current workspace permissions before inviting collaborators.

### How do I adjust a keyframe animation after setting the keyframes?

Return to the keyframes and revise their values or placement. Play the sequence to see how the changes affect the motion.

### How can keyframes be combined with a speed curve?

Combine keyframe animation with the speed-curve tool to create non-linear motion with acceleration and deceleration. Review the transition at normal playback speed before export.

### Can keyframes animate opacity and color changes?

Set keyframes for opacity or color to create fades and gradual visual changes over time. Keep the change subtle enough that text, subjects, and other important elements remain clear.

### Does CapCut interpolate movement between keyframes?

Interpolation generates movement between keyframes, helping create smoother transitions without adjusting every frame manually. Preview the motion and reposition keyframes if the timing feels uneven.

### Which properties can I animate with keyframes?

Keyframes can animate position, scale, rotation, shape, opacity, and color. Set the starting and ending values, then preview the movement between them.
